title: Tight paths in fully directed hypergraphs
summary: It is well-known that every tournament has a spanning path. We consider hypergraph analogues. In an \emph{$r$-uniform fully directed hypergraph}, or \emph{$r$-digraph}, every edge is a list or $r$ distinct vertices. An $(r,k)$-tournament is an $r$-digraph $G$ such that for every $r$-set $S$ of vertices in $G$, exactly $k$ of the orderings of $S$ are edges in $G$. A \emph{directed tight path} is an $r$-digraph $G$ whose vertices can be ordered so that the intervals of size $r$ are the edges in $G$.
